item.title: Classic Halo Trilogy Gets Brand-New Release on Nov. 10
item.description: It's been a busy year for Halo fans, with plenty of new releases and surprises keeping the franchise alive. Halo: Campaign Evolved , a remake of the original game, is bringing Master Chief's first adventure to a new generation, while a tabletop adaptation is also in development . Even Halo Infinite isn't quite ready to call it quits, continuing to receive unexpected updates this year despite its major content support coming to an end.

item.title: The brutal reality of making video games in 2026 | Point It Out!
item.description: This week on Point It Out, Patches assembled an all star roundtable of indie gaming creators to discuss the state of the industry, its future and what it takes to make successful games like Shovel Knight, Hyper Light Drifter, Mina and more. Plus, WoW Forever is officially coming out, and Arkane Lyon may have a buyer. All this and more in the bouchon that is Point It Out!

item.title: All Great Fairy's Fountain locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Great Fairy's Fountains are home to, well, Great Fairies in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. The Great Fairies are your gateway to magic and abilities. They'll give you spells that let you create fire, teleport in and out of dungeons, and grant yourself temporary invulnerability.

item.title: How to find Richard the dog in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Finding Richard is a side quest in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. You might have seen Richard, the adorable dog, during your first visit to Hyrule Castle Town: a white energetic dog that you couldn’t pet because its owner would accuse you of trying to steal her dog. If you visit the town again later, you will learn that Richard has disappeared.

item.title: 3 Near-Perfect Sci-Fi Movies You Can Stream For Free This Weekend (Novemeber 6 - 8)
item.description: Science Fiction as a genre is one that fans get to explore in many different ways. Whether it is a horror movie or a comedy, elements of science fiction can turn a story into something so memorable for fans. And sometimes, you just want to watch a movie that has something a little more to it for you to unpack. The problem is trying to figure out what the best science fiction movie is to watch and with a large library of the genre online, picking the best of the best isn't easy.

item.title: James Cameron’s Avatar Franchise Gets a Massive New December Release
item.description: James Cameron is giving Avatar: Fire and Ash another home-video release, and this one comes with enough behind-the-scenes material to keep Pandora fans busy for several hours. 20th Century Studios has announced a new Collector's Edition 4K Blu-ray, arriving this December, with more than six hours of previously unreleased bonus features.

item.title: Zelda Ocarina of Time guides and walkthroughs
item.description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake for Nintendo Switch 2 is more than just a graphical overhaul of the game. Some of the puzzles you may remember from the original game have been changed, and Link can even jump now. Rather than racking your brain trying to remember how you beat the Water Temple back in 1998 (or perhaps 2003 or 2011), let us guide the way.

item.title: Fortune treasure hours schedule in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite is continuing the tradition of special Saturday hourly events during the Chapter 7 mini season , though this time they're treasure hours , centered around the pirate-themed "Treasure Hunters" season. During these hours, certain sprites will get increased drop rates, and you'll drop into the game with special items.

item.title: Magic’s Most Broken New Mechanic Perfectly Captures the Essence of Star Trek
item.description: If there’s one thing I do know about Star Trek, however, it’s that its vision of the future is brimming with optimism and curiosity. In tandem with that is an emphasis on the importance of diversity. I remember my dad watching Star Trek: The Next Generation when I was very young, and the “Wookiee guy” kind of scared me. These days, Worf (who is actually a Klingon) would probably be my favorite character. So it makes sense that what finally won me over about Magic' s Trek connects directly to the franchise's idealistic core message.
